result.instructions: Tools for Cuéntica, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which customer invoices are still unpaid, and how much do they total?"; "List the expenses from last quarter for the provider Iberdrola."; "Create a new customer for a company with this tax id and address.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Cuéntica data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run cuentica_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cuentica_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cuentica_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. cuentica_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cuentica_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: Create a customer. Required: business_type, address, town, postal_code; business_name for companies; name and surname_1 for individuals. Cuéntica API: POST /customer.

business_type.description: individual = sole trader, company = legal company, others = community of goods or institution.

tradename.description: Trade name. Required for companies. Cuéntica creates one for individuals when omitted.

business_name.description: Legal name. Required when business_type is company or others.

name.description: First name. Required when business_type is individual.

surname_1.description: First surname. Required when business_type is individual.

tax_id.description: Tax id (NIF, CIF or foreign id).

tax_id_type.description: Type of tax id. Cuéntica uses the country default when omitted.

default_payment_method.description: Default payment method for this party.

has_surcharge.description: Apply the equivalence surcharge to this customer.

tools.name: cuentica_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices, paged. issued=true lists issued invoices; issued=false lists drafts. Cuéntica API: GET /invoice.

customer.description: Only invoices of this customer id.

initial_date.description: Invoices dated after this date, yyyy-MM-dd.

end_date.description: Invoices dated before this date, yyyy-MM-dd.

min_total_limit.description: Invoices with a total above this amount.

max_total_limit.description: Invoices with a total below this amount.

sort.description: Sort as key:order pairs, e.g. customer:desc. Keys: customer, description, total_base, total_invoice, number, date. Orders: asc, desc.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags. A result must contain all of them.

page_size.description: Items per page, 1-300. Default set by Cuéntica.
